Hi

I noticed you pulled the KBOX from your website. Are you not planning on selling them anymore? If so, I think its best that you refund me.

Thanks

Saethor
Note to the team: I'll pull the order up before I answer.
Read the gekkoscience kbox 22 th s page
Handed to the team · KBOX listing is off the storefront; nobody can tell the customer whether his uni

Hi Saethor,

You are right that the KBOX listing is off the site at the moment. I am not able to say from here whether it is coming back, so I have put that question to the team. They are offline until 10am ET today and will come back to you by email with a straight answer.

What I can do right now, without waiting on anyone. Your order is still unshipped, so I can move it to another unit today. The B. BS-4 (18 TH/s) is $599.99 and ships from the manufacturer by Oct 31, 2026, which is the miner you originally wanted. That one leaves $200.01, which would go back to you as store credit on your account. The other option is the Magic Miner 40T at $799, a pre-order that ships by Dec 7, 2026, with $1.00 back.

If you would rather not pick a replacement at all, I can also put the full value of the order on your account as store credit to use whenever you like.

I am sorry about the wait on this one. You ordered on Sep 24, the Sep 30 date came and went, and the last thing you heard from us was Oct 9.

Tell me which of those you want and I will do it in the same reply, or wait for the team's answer on the KBOX first if you prefer.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi

Since you don’t have the KBox in stock and no shipping date on it I would like to request a refund.

Thanks

Saethor A.
Handed to the team · Customer has asked twice for his money back on an unshipped KBOX with no ship da

Hi Saethor,

Understood, and thank you for being patient with this one. Cancelling is not something we do as a matter of course, so the request goes to a supervisor for review, and it is with one of them now. They will come back to you directly with the decision.

Before they do, one last thing worth saying, because it is in your hands either way. The B. BS-4 is live again at $599.99 and ships from the manufacturer by Oct 31, which is the miner you set out to buy in the first place, and the $200.01 difference would sit on your account as store credit. The other way round is the full $835 as store credit, no unit chosen, usable on anything whenever you want it. Both of those I can do today, in minutes, and neither waits on an approval.

If you would rather just have the money back, do nothing and the supervisor's answer will reach you here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

I have already ordered the BS-4. I don’t need another one. I ordered the KBox because the BS-4 was not available and the KBox was supposed to ship on September 30th. It didn’t and while I waited the BS-4 became available. I want a refund on the KBox unless you can give me a solid shipping date.

Hi Saethor,

You are right, and I should have spotted that. Your BS-4 is on Shop···· from Oct 9 and ships Oct 31, so there is no sense in me pointing you at a second one. Sorry for that.

On the KBOX, I do not have a solid shipping date to give you and I am not going to invent one. The S. 30 date on your order passed, the listing is off the site, and nothing on my side carries a replacement date.

So your refund request on Shop···· is with a supervisor as of Monday and sits with them until they come back to you. I cannot process it myself or promise an amount or a day, but they have everything they need, including that the KBOX has no date, and their answer comes to you in this thread.

If anything about the BS-4 order needs looking at in the meantime, just say and I will handle that one straight away.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
